hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers the afterInitialize permission (callback is a no-op). Pool initialization is performed via the separate `initializePools()` function, which delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract and records the initial tick and initialized state.
